# Propagent

> Propagent is the proposal system for AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) firms: it runs every stage of an RFP response — bid intake, gap analysis, Go / No-Go, answer coordination, and response maturity — on one system that learns from every submission, with a source behind every claim.

Pricing starts at $1,000/month (up to 25 responses a year); tiers are based on annual response volume, not seat counts. AI agents are welcome on this site — it is fully static, server-rendered HTML with schema.org JSON-LD, and exposes a conversational endpoint at POST /api/ask.

## Docs

- [Full site facts](https://www.propagent.ai/llms-full.txt): everything about Propagent in one plain-text file — product, five workflow stages, trust layer, pricing tiers, FAQ, and the /api/ask contract for agents
- [Homepage](https://www.propagent.ai/): product overview, workflow, pricing, and demo booking

## Tools

- [RFP Grader](https://www.propagent.ai/rfp-grader/): free — upload an RFP or past response, get a graded report by email (12 dimensions, killer clauses, Go / No-Go read)
- [Ask Propagent API](https://www.propagent.ai/llms-full.txt): POST /api/ask with {"message": "...", "agent": true} for grounded JSON answers about the product

## Contact

- [Book a proposal review](https://www.propagent.ai/#contact): 30 minutes, bring a real opportunity, leave with the artifact
